H0 (engine drop-bug on chat/native paths): falsified by executing the real source logic; with the top-k field set the engine populates per-token top-k end to end (tokenizer_manager.py:1590-1591, sampler.py consumes top_logprobs_nums). Uncertainty: k-cap not found by grep (20 chosen per OpenAI convention); if the probe used an unseen wrapper, the falsifier table covers all three endpoints.
